story.iWant: to filter my analytics by date range
story.soThat: I can analyze performance for specific time periods

tasks.task: Update analytics store to support date range filtering (AC: #1, #4)
Update API endpoints to accept date range parameters (AC: #1, #2, #3)
Update repository layer to filter by date range (AC: #1, #2, #3)
Update analytics components to use date range filter (AC: #1, #4, #6)
Create date range utilities and helpers (AC: #2, #3)
Add error handling and edge cases (AC: #3, #6)

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Given I am viewing analytics, When I select a date range (date picker or predefined ranges: last week, month, 3 months, year, all time), Then the system: Updates all analytics views to show data only for selected date range, Refreshes charts, metrics, and statistics, Shows active filter indicator ("Showing: Last 3 months"), Smooth transition/animation when data updates (< 300ms), Maintains filter selection across page navigation

Given I am viewing analytics, When I select a predefined date range preset (last week, last month, last 3 months, last year, all time), Then the system: Applies the date range filter immediately, Calculates start and end dates based on preset selection, Updates all analytics components to reflect the filtered data, Shows the preset name in the filter indicator

Given I am viewing analytics, When I select a custom date range using the date picker, Then the system: Opens date picker component (ShadCN/UI DatePicker), Allows selection of start date and end date, Validates date range (start date ≤ end date, dates not in future), Applies custom date range filter, Updates all analytics components with custom range

Given I have applied a date range filter, When I navigate to different analytics sections (role metrics, ELO trends, win rates, etc.), Then the system: Maintains the active date range filter across all sections, All analytics components show data for the same date range, Filter indicator remains visible and consistent

Given I have applied a date range filter, When I clear the date range filter, Then the system: Resets to default "all time" view, Updates all analytics components to show all available data, Removes filter indicator, Smoothly transitions back to unfiltered view

Given I am viewing analytics with a date range filter applied, When the data is loading, Then the system: Shows loading states in all affected analytics components, Displays filter indicator with loading state, Maintains filter selection during loading

constraints.constraint: Clean Architecture + Hexagonal Architecture: DateRangeFilter component in Presentation Layer (src/components/analytics/), date range utilities in Application Layer (src/lib/utils/), date range filtering in Infrastructure Layer repositories (src/infrastructure/persistence/)

Use repository pattern in Infrastructure Layer for database queries. Date range filtering should be added to existing repositories (role-metrics, elo-trends, win-rate, performance-summary, trends, role-comparison). Follow established patterns from previous stories (4-1, 4-2, 4-3, 4-4)

Use TanStack Query for server state (analytics data) with 5min stale time, 10min GC time. Date range must be part of query key to ensure proper cache invalidation. Use Zustand for client state (dateRange filter) via useAnalyticsStore() hook. Filter changes must trigger data refetch across all analytics components

Use ShadCN/UI DatePicker component for custom date selection. Use preset buttons (last week, last month, last 3 months, last year, all time) for quick selection. Filter indicator component displays active filter with clear button. Use Tailwind CSS 3.3.0 with tailwind-variants for component variants. Maintain responsive design (mobile-first: 320px, 768px, 1024px breakpoints)

API response time target: < 500ms for aggregated data. Filter update target: < 300ms for data refresh. Use database indexes on game_date column for efficient date range filtering. Implement TanStack Query caching with date range as part of cache key. Optimize component re-renders when date range changes

All analytics endpoints require authentication via NextAuth.js session. Users can only access their own data (player ID must match session user). Validate date range parameters (startDate ≤ endDate, dates not in future) to prevent invalid queries

Use Zod 4.1.12 for API request/response validation. Add date range validation schemas (date format ISO 8601, startDate ≤ endDate, no future dates). Return proper error responses (400 for invalid date ranges)

Maintain minimum 80% test coverage for all new code. Use Vitest 1.0.0 for unit/integration tests, React Testing Library for component tests, Playwright 1.56.1 for E2E tests. Component tests at tests/components/analytics/, integration tests at tests/integration/api/analytics/, unit tests at tests/unit/utils/

Handle invalid date range selections (start > end, future dates) with user-friendly error messages. Handle edge cases (no data in date range, single day range, timezone edge cases). Display loading states during filter changes. Handle network errors gracefully
Smooth transitions when filter changes (< 300ms). Use opacity transitions and skeleton screens for smooth UX. Maintain filter selection during loading states

interface.name: DateRange
interface.signature: interface DateRange { startDate?: string | null; endDate?: string | null; preset?: 'last_week' | 'last_month' | 'last_3_months' | 'last_year' | 'all_time' | null; }

interface.name: GET /api/players/[id]/analytics/*
interface.signature: GET /api/players/[id]/analytics/{endpoint}?startDate?&endDate? Query Parameters: startDate (optional, ISO 8601), endDate (optional, ISO 8601). Response: unchanged analytics data filtered by date range. Error Codes: 400 (Invalid date range), 404 (Player not found)

interface.name: DateRangeFilterProps
interface.signature: interface DateRangeFilterProps { value: DateRange | null; onChange: (range: DateRange | null) => void; presets?: DateRangePreset[]; }

interface.name: FilterIndicatorProps
interface.signature: interface FilterIndicatorProps { dateRange: DateRange | null; onClear: () => void; isLoading?: boolean; }

interface.name: useAnalyticsStore
interface.signature: const useAnalyticsStore = create<AnalyticsState>(). Returns: { dateRange: DateRange | null; setDateRange: (range: DateRange | null) => void; clearDateRange: () => void; reset: () => void; }

interface.name: calculatePresetDateRange
interface.signature: function calculatePresetDateRange(preset: DateRangePreset): { startDate: string; endDate: string }

interface.name: validateDateRange
interface.signature: function validateDateRange(startDate: string, endDate: string): { valid: boolean; error?: string }

tests.standards: Maintain minimum 80% test coverage for all new code. Use Vitest 1.0.0 for unit/integration tests with @vitest/coverage-v8. Use React Testing Library 16.0.0 for component tests. Use Playwright 1.56.1 for E2E tests. All tests must be deterministic and not depend on external services. Use mocks for API calls and database queries in unit tests. Integration tests should use test database. Component tests should test rendering, user interactions, loading states, and error states.

test.description: Test DateRangeFilter component: preset buttons (last week, last month, last 3 months, last year, all time) update Zustand store correctly, custom date picker opens and allows date selection, filter indicator displays active filter, all analytics components update within 300ms, filter persists across navigation

Test preset date range calculation: calculatePresetDateRange correctly calculates start and end dates for each preset (last week: 7 days ago to today, last month: 30 days ago to today, last 3 months: 90 days ago to today, last year: 365 days ago to today, all time: null/null), preset name displays correctly in filter indicator

Test custom date range: DatePicker component opens and allows start/end date selection, validateDateRange rejects invalid ranges (start > end, future dates) with error messages, valid custom range applies filter correctly, custom range displays correctly in filter indicator

Test filter persistence: date range filter maintains across navigation to different analytics sections (role metrics, ELO trends, win rates, summary, trends, comparison), all analytics components show data for same date range, filter indicator remains visible and consistent

Test filter clearing: clear button resets dateRange to null (all time), all analytics components update to show all available data, filter indicator is removed, smooth transition back to unfiltered view

Test loading states: when date range filter applied and data loading, all affected analytics components show loading states (skeleton screens), filter indicator shows loading state, filter selection maintained during loading

Test API endpoints with date range: all 6 endpoints accept startDate and endDate query parameters, validate date format (ISO 8601), validate date range (start ≤ end, no future dates), filter data correctly by date range, return 400 for invalid date ranges

Test repository date filtering: repositories filter games by date range efficiently using indexed game_date column, handle edge cases (no games in range, single day range), optimize queries for performance
Test analytics store: setDateRange updates dateRange state correctly, clearDateRange resets to null, filter changes trigger TanStack Query refetch across components, state persists across navigation

Test performance: API response with date range filter completes in < 500ms, filter update triggers data refresh in < 300ms, database queries use indexes efficiently, TanStack Query caching works correctly with date range in cache key

Test edge cases: invalid date formats, start date after end date, future dates, no data in date range, single day range, timezone edge cases (daylight saving transitions), very large date ranges, concurrent filter changes

Test responsive layout: DateRangeFilter stacks vertically on mobile (320px), horizontal layout on desktop (1024px+), FilterIndicator adapts to screen size, touch targets meet 44x44px minimum on mobile
